tagline: Asks why things work, then builds a tiny robot to find out.

chat.text: Hey, I'm your Wingmate. Let's start easy: tell me about yourself and what a good week looks like.

I'm the kind of person who can spend one conversation asking what love really is and the next figuring out whether static electricity could pull cat hair off a sweater in one swipe. I want to know how things work, and why they have to work the way they do.
Nice. What do your weekends usually look like?
Weekends are hiking, a design side project, or an indoor-skydiving session. And sometimes I just want to make a tiny robot do something ridiculous.
Food is a big signal. What are you always down to eat?
I'm happy with simple food done well. I recently went down a rabbit hole on how to poach an egg properly.
What else do you do to move, make, or unwind?
I'm learning industrial design and aesthetics, not just software, and I love films about minds and AI like Her and Pantheon.
How's work, and does it leave you energy for dating?
I feel most alive when I'm coming up with a new idea and watching a vague possibility start to take shape.
What's your relationship with drinking?
I drink socially.
Any smoking, vaping or similar I should know about, for you or in a match?
I don't smoke or vape.
How do you feel about having kids someday?
I want kids.
Pets? A dog, a cat, allergies, none?
I don't have pets, but I notice animals a lot. I always wonder what a purring cat is actually feeling.
How important are religion or spirituality to you, and what values matter most?
I'm spiritual. I value honesty and real thinking over comfortable reassurance.
Morning person or night owl?
I'm a night owl.
What are you hoping to find in a partner?
someone curious and playful with their own vivid inner world, who brings ideas and a little surprise too.
Any hard dealbreakers I should screen for?
No hard deal breakers.
Last one: when are you free for a first date this coming week?
Monday or Tuesday evening, Wednesday after seven, or Friday evening all work.
Thanks, that's plenty to work with. I'll look for matches quietly and keep your private details private until you both opt in.
